# Why eBay is setting its sights on live shopping as a growth lever


By[Megan Robinson](https://www.retail-week.com/megan-robinson/3001908.bio)


2026-08-13T14:38:00


Source: eBay


This year has certainly been one to remember for the 30-year old eBay. In February, it was revealed that eBay would[purchase](https://www.retail-week.com/fashion/ebay-snaps-up-secondhand-fashion-app-depop-from-etsy/7050598.article) secondhand fashion platform Depop for $1.2bn, but the acquisition was[only completed](https://www.retail-week.com/marketplaces/cma-gives-the-green-light-for-ebays-depop-acquisition/7051652.article) at the end of July after the Competition and Markets Authority (CMA) gave the deal the green light.
